verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's local-first/self-hosted architecture (docs-1, docs-2, docs-8) implies users retain full physical control over their data and can delete it by managing their own filesystem/database, and opt-in cloud usage (comm-11) supports a privacy-by-default posture. However, there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, in-app data deletion controls, or admin tooling for purging chat/document history. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion settings or admin UI documentation, evidence of a data export/delete workflow, independent confirmation that deletion actually removes underlying data.
